title: Rav Huna Mar bar Avya
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Chullin 47a](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.47a.5), raising an objection to Rav Ashi and saying: “All these animals of the open field have it this way.” He is likewise mentioned there at 58b according to Dikdukei Soferim.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The discussion concerns an extra lobe of an animal’s lung. [Rashi](https://www.sefaria.org/Rashi_on_Chullin.47a.5.1) explains ברייתא as animals grazing in the meadow and gives “healthy and fat” as an alternative.

In the linked Gemara, Rav Huna Mar bar Avya addresses Rav Ashi, as [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=994&lang=en) also records. Heilprin reports bar Chiyya at 58b. Hyman reports a reading of Dikdukei Soferim at that later passage.
